notes.en:
• Account balances show exactly two decimal places in the avatar menu and account settings. Display rounding does not change the stored balance or billing.
• In version 1.1.3, update actions open the official download page at https://api.90z.cn/download. Older clients keep the compatible GitHub release entry.
• Existing account sign-in, API providers, local conversations, Windows corner improvements and manual installation behavior remain.
notes.zh-CN:
• 头像菜单和账号设置的余额统一显示两位小数，仅调整显示，不改变实际余额或计费。
• 1.1.3 客户端的更新按钮打开官网下载页 https://api.90z.cn/download；旧客户端继续使用兼容的 GitHub 发布页。
• 保留账号登录、原有 API 服务、本地会话、Windows 圆角改进和手动安装方式。
